1077|75241b9c.name: Prospector Whelgar
1077|75241b9c.text: Oh my, this is quite historical.  A monumental find.  But these wretched beasts!  Merrin seems to be handling the situation quite well.  Now if I could just piece together this complicated puzzle. . . .

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

270-complete.name: Glorin Steelbrow
270-complete.text:
Lightforge Iron is a precious metal, but it sounds like your quest is a dire one.  You've come a long way, Brother.  With luck, you might just find what you seek!

And if you do get the iron, I know who can fashion it into a weapon against this Necromancer you speak of in Duskwood.
270-complete.title: The Doomed Fleet

321-accept.name: Glorin Steelbrow
321-accept.text:
The shipwrecks off the shore here are the doomed Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras, burned and sunk by Red Dragons during the last Great War.

The Fleet hailed from Lordaeron, but one ship, an Elvish Destroyer: Flying Osprey, was with it.  It was shipping a load of Lightforge Iron and joined the Third Fleet for protection.  Ironic that it sunk to the same dragons...

Enough history.  The Flying Osprey is wrecked to the south of Menethil Harbor.  If you find the Lightforge Iron there, bring it to me.
321-accept.title: Lightforge Iron

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

95795-accept.name: Unknown
95795-accept.text:
<You cover the $r's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795-accept.title: Fallen in the Fen

95809-accept.name: Unknown
95809-accept.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809-accept.title: Heartwoven

95809-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-progress.text: I'm more than worried about him!
95809-progress.title: Heartwoven

98815-progress.name: James Halloran
98815-progress.text: Welcome back, $c. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
